summary.text: In June 2026 remarks, Ratcliffe said that when he became Director he made emerging technologies a top priority alongside China, and that CIA must excel in AI because algorithmic decisions and data affect U.S. strategic advantage and national security. He described frontier AI capabilities as akin to “digital nuclear weapons” and said the U.S. cannot afford to wait for a risk-free approach to emerging technology, must move fast and aggressively, and must master technology better than adversaries who seek to steal and manipulate American advancements. He also said widespread AI adoption is transforming CIA business and that advances in AI, quantum, and biotech are rewriting conflict, with AI-powered robots and drones potentially having devastating battlefield lethality. In a January 2025 statement, Ratcliffe said AI and machine learning can help the intelligence community find the signal in large volumes of data and spend more time using intelligence.

statements.text: For instance, when we talk about utilizing artificial intelligence and machine learning, there is so much data that's out there in this great technological age that we live in, that sometimes the intelligence community spends so much time sifting through the data that they can't find the signal for the noise. In other words, so that we can find the intelligence, spend more time using the intelligence, and less time looking for it.
